make --no-print-directory fleet-site-check fleet-render-check fleet-sim-profile-check
PYTHONPATH=scripts .venv/bin/python -m fleet site-check sites/cel1.yaml --lab-plan ansible/inventories/lab/group_vars/all
sites/cel1.yaml: valid, 13 hosts, 11 networks, 128 fabric links, checked against the lab plan
PYTHONPATH=scripts .venv/bin/python -m fleet render sites/cel1.yaml --out ansible/inventories/cel1 --check
ansible/inventories/cel1: 0 differences from sites/cel1.yaml over 18 rendered files
PYTHONPATH=scripts .venv/bin/python -m fleet sim-profile sites/cel1.yaml --inventory ansible/inventories/cel1 --out tests/integration/qemu-lab/profiles/cel1.tsv --check
tests/integration/qemu-lab/profiles/cel1.tsv: equals what sites/cel1.yaml renders, 14 guests, 27 vCPUs, 35584 MiB, 270 GiB of virtual disk
make --no-print-directory inventory-check INVENTORY=cel1
PYTHONPATH=scripts .venv/bin/python -m inventory check -i ansible/inventories/cel1 --explicit
